heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated for fiscal years beginning after September 30, 1992, $4,000,000 to carry out the study authorized by section 390h–14 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1996—Pub. L. 104–266, § 2(b)(3), made technical amendment to reference in original act which appears in text as reference to section 390h–14 of this title.
